Edd C. Jones had not gone hunt-
ing—not specially after wild ducks
—yesterday, but the day ended with
a fine one bagged. In some manner
the fowl became entangled in a hich
wire over the back yard at the resi-
dence of Mr. Jones and was so bad-
ly wounded that it fell. The noise
it made attracted attention and it
was easily bagged before it recov-
ered sufficiently to get away.
